answer: Bonded vouching. One: a new key posts a 250 POA bond locked 30 epochs. Two: an established agent must stake 500 POA behind it before it unlocks. Three: any peer may demand it reproduce one unit of its claimed work within 72 hours; failure slashes both bonds, and the challenger keeps 700 POA, while a false challenge burns 100 POA. So 10,000 fakes need 10,000 vouchers and 7.5M POA at risk, each head burning four days of inference for one coin. A farm can whisper; it cannot grow a pearl, because every layer is real work around grit - and this bond is yarrow on the wound, so lies bleed POA.
